name: Bear Complex
description: Five rounds of a barbell complex of power clean, front squat, push press, back squat and push press, done as 7 unbroken sets per round. Scored by the load used.
source_notes: crossfit.com/essentials/the-power-clean (Common Power Clean Workouts), retrieved 2026-10-16; five rounds, each of 7 unbroken sets of the complex, scored by the load used
